scope: Direct cooked/raw Rust doc attributes and mixed mapped text on existing owners; Unit1 of #1664

audit_corrections.carrier_work: For W plain doc attributes, item readers examine #, [, attribute (returning before ]): 3W. Direct attribute readers examine path, =, value: 3W. Typed/raw collections are measured separately across (0,N), (N,1), (N,N) depth/width controls.
audit_corrections.piece_work: N four-byte hex escapes clone 4N responsible one-byte pieces or N contiguous token pieces through the actual copy_with_budget loop; retained queries clone zero pieces. Duplicate decoded-origin copying yields 8N split-piece clones.
audit_corrections.continuation_budget: Whitespace-only LF continuation charges N+2 bytes; CRLF charges N+3. Failing byte 3/4 respectively precedes any source-piece step, append checkpoint or output copy.
audit_corrections.unicode_budget: Each clean parsed 1F600 token charges backslash + u + five digits + closing brace (8 bytes), then two four-byte append charges: 16N total, N source-piece steps, 2N checkpoints, N copies. Failure at byte 3 precedes piece gathering and append.
audit_corrections.nested_graph: Exact existing test fixture: f24..62, body31..62, g51..60, root0..62. Both associated_document identity and lexical_scope are asserted separately from enumeration/content and through prepared owner/node queries.
audit_corrections.grammar_evidence: Representative q, short hex, underscore Unicode, missing bracket and included path/value-gap assertions preserve the previously captured pinned grammar fields/ranges/flags. has_error, is_error and is_missing are separate observations.
audit_corrections.runtime_obligation: Three unconditional observation recorders add production overhead; test-only accessors do not make that overhead free. Counter/budget tests establish only their named work, not a universal complexity or performance bound. Runtime qualification remains pending.

independent_derivations.mixed_margin: Sugared '     hello' has margin five; nonsugared 'another' participates with add=1. Global minimum one removes one from the comment and zero from the attribute: four spaces remain.
independent_derivations.empty_join: Each empty prose fragment contributes an assembly LF; one final assembly LF is removed. Two empty attributes produce one LF.
independent_derivations.same_row: Single-line interiors ' a ' and ' b ' lose their common left space, preserving both right spaces: 'a \nb '. Physical legacy DLOC remains one.
independent_derivations.decoded_crlf: Cooked a\r\nb decodes CR and LF separately. str::lines removes CR; LF output maps only to the complete \n escape. Physical CRLF instead maps to both physical bytes.
independent_derivations.unicode_underscores: Pinned grammar recovers \u{1_f600} into ERROR plus a missing-delimiter value. Production content is GrammarBoundary; the decoder's valid underscore syntax cannot establish lost supplied-tree boundaries.
